summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.16/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.16 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 30, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 15¢ lower than a week ago, 41¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.42 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Madison ($3.93) and the highest in Marshfield ($4.33).
